description: Shows, hides or deletes one of the animated overlays (listed by huasheng_list_clips detail="full"). Add or change one via huasheng_ask_agent. Hiding is reversible; remove=true deletes (a version restore undoes it) — only if asked or failed. To change what an animation says, ask Huasheng itself with huasheng_ask_agent. A successful show/hide response completes that request: do not inspect other animations or export the video unless the user also asked for it.

animation.description: Its id, from the animations list in huasheng_list_clips

client_action_id.description: MCP App only: submission id; reuse for the same click. Models omit.

pid.description: Video id (15 digits); default: this machine's current video.

ui_lang.description: MCP App only: follow-up language. Models omit.

visible.description: true shows it, false hides it

name: huasheng_set_animation_visibility

client_action_id.description: App-supplied id; repeats reuse the first result

applied.description: Whether the change has landed. If false, track action.operation.id and follow action.next_call when present

can_be.description: When only reading: what it accepts

current.description: When only reading: the current value

label.description: Human-readable name of the changed setting

note.description: What to do next, in plain words

url.description: Link to the video in Huasheng

title: Show, hide or delete a motion-graphics overlay
